tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background (body): a warm near-black, like a screening room with the lights down.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Grouped regions: chat sidebar, hero text panel, filter panel, navbar once scrolled.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised blocks: movie card info, auth form, detail modal, assistant chat bubble, list rows.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of blocks on surface-200, skeletons, genre chip fill, poster placeholder.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section rules, card outlines, the ticket perforation. Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, secondary buttons, unselected star buttons, checkboxes. At least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, movie titles, message text. Reads on every surface-000…300 and on image-veil.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: overviews, section descriptions, recommendation reasons, timestamps. Reads on every surface-000…300.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Secondary mono metadata (year, page counts, result counts) and input placeholders. 4.5:1 on surface-000/100/200; never on surface-300.

tokens.name: marquee
tokens.usage: Identity colour (the marquee bulb). Fill for the primary button, selected stars, the active nav/tab marker. Text on it is on-marquee.

tokens.name: marquee-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button and selected chips.

tokens.name: on-marquee
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a marquee fill.

tokens.name: marquee-text
tokens.usage: Yellow text and links on surfaces: 'View details', 'Sign in to rate', highlighted IMDb scores. Reads on surface-000…200.

tokens.name: velvet
tokens.usage: Secondary identity colour (seat velvet). Fill for the 'For you' stamp, Top 10 rank stamps, Favourite when on. Text on it is on-velvet. Never used for errors.

tokens.name: on-velvet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a velvet fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text (role=alert) and the delete icon on hover. Always paired with words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations: 'Account created', the Watch later check. Always paired with a word or ✓.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible ring, 3px offset, on every control. Solid, at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Flat overlay behind the movie detail modal. Never a gradient.

tokens.name: image-veil
tokens.usage: Flat veil over poster/backdrop art when ink text sits on an image (card hover overlay, trailer-less backdrop). Replaces gradient fades.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing headline and the featured title in the hero. Once per screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Movie title in the detail modal; the auth page headline.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Page H1 on Search, Library, Chat, History and Filters.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Section headings (For you, Top rated, New releases, Similar). Italic so they read like programme chapter heads.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Explore picks for you, top rated movies, and the latest releases.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under an H1; the hero synopsis.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years.
styles.usage: Default copy: overviews, chat messages, forms.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Matches your taste · Highly rated on IMDb
styles.usage: Recommendation reasons, list notes, card titles, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, tabs, nav links, form labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above an H1 or on the hero. At most one per block.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Movie metadata as printed on a ticket: IMDb score, year, runtime, result counts, 'Page 2 / 9', dates.

styles.name: rank
styles.usage: Large Top 10 rank numerals beside a poster; always two digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside buttons; between meta lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in LibraryActions, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card info padding; gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of forms, chat bubbles, modal blocks, panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section heading to row; tablet page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on Browse; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the hero and landing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Posters, buttons, inputs: near-square, like a paper ticket.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Movie cards, chat bubbles, forms, panels, dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Detail modal frame, hero backdrop.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Genre chips, star buttons, chat suggestion chips, filter chips.

shadow.note: Hairlines over shadows. Only blocks floating above the scrim get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Detail modal and the account menu only.
